pkgmetadata.longdescription: Mochi is a small, local-first desktop companion (GTK4 + Cairo) for Linux. It reacts to typing, idle/away time, media playback and window activity. All processing is local: it never reads typed content, window titles, document names or the clipboard, makes no network request and sends no telemetry.

use.flag: Install the optional GNOME Shell helper extension that provides typing/activity signals and Mochi's global shortcut on GNOME. The extension targets GNOME Shell 50 and must be enabled per user.

Keep the bundled GitHub self-updater (the automatic update check, the "Check for updates" menu entry and the mochi-update command). Disabled by default because a system-wide install is updated through Portage.
